firmware.title: Digger
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev; Andrew Jenner
firmware.description: Digger Remastered, the 1983 PC arcade game: tunnel for emeralds and gold and dodge the Nobbins. CGA graphics, two players.
firmware.controls: PS/2 or USB keyboard. Arrows: move, F1: fire/start, Space: pause, F7: music, F9: sound.
